answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13390 Country: United States of America Title: Assalamualikum, We live in Los Angeles,USA. We have been praying our Jummah and other Satat in a rented place for a long time. It is not a parmanent masjid.From the last Ramadan we started second Jumma Jamat in the same place. Can we offer second Jumma Jamat or second Jamat for any other prayer in the same place? Please let us know. May Allah bless us all. Question: Assalamualikum, We live in Los Angeles,USA. We have been praying our Jummah and other Satat in a rented place for a long time. It is not a parmanent masjid.From the last Ramadan we started second Jumma Jamat in the same place. Can we offer second Jumma Jamat or second Jamat for any other prayer in the same place? Please let us know. May Allah bless us all. Answer ID: 13390 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 882/882=M/1430) If it is not permanently a legal mosque, rather a temporary worship place, so holding the second jama?ah of Jumu?ah or any salah is not makrooh. It is lawful, but holding one jama?ah is better; since it demonstrates the unity of Muslims and their grandeur. And, this is the motto of the jama?ah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
